name: cjm-design-system
summary: A design system as data (ruling a439c226): token schema v1 with its check and its headless resolution into one flat vocabulary, the CSS custom-properties projection for the web, the vendored seed systems (Classical, Netrunner) with their fonts, and the importer for a web-first system's CSS. No Qt: the Qt kit (cjm-substrate-qt-kit) consumes the same tokens. Born on-graph.
